invariants.rule: ESP32_B must use the manufactured Logic Carrier between the MCU and every Power Stage; no direct replacement pinmap or bypass is allowed.
ENABLE_CH0 through ENABLE_CH3 must be driven low and PWM forced low before any other output initialization.
GPIO19 EN_GLOBAL is input-only, must not enable native USB/JTAG on ESP32_B, and must never be driven or internally pulled high.

FAULT_N_CH0 through FAULT_N_CH3 are active-low inputs; a falling edge immediately cuts that channel, while a reset-required firmware latch is confirmed after twenty consecutive 1 ms output samples remain low. Up to two shorter pulses may each auto-recover only after ten consecutive HIGH samples, but a third falling edge within five seconds must latch the channel to prevent repeated self-clearing fault retries. A high level alone does not prove connector presence.
Output enable requires a valid full CH0-CH3 command, live TTL, and EN_GLOBAL high; each channel additionally requires its own FAULT_N high, independent of other channels.
Safe-off lowers channel enable first, then forces PWM low and applies the safe direction state.
J7 and J10 even pins are GND; connector orientation and pin 1 must be verified on the physical assembly before power is applied.
Logic Carrier J6 5V injection and a USB cable that sources DevKit power must not be used simultaneously.

During a healthy active lease ENABLE_CHx remains statically high across SPWM zero crossings and direction blanking. Direction changes require PWM force-low, a blanking interval, direction update, and safety-input recheck before PWM resumes; any disable or safety condition drives ENABLE_CHx low.
Maximum modulation index remains below 1.0 to preserve IRS2104 bootstrap refresh; firmware and the end-to-end protocol currently limit it to 0.60, the configured fully transparent operating point.
ADC raw or millivolt telemetry must not be presented as calibrated amperes or degrees Celsius, or used for new software protection thresholds, until board measurements provide calibration and limits.
The E-Stop gates CHx_ENABLE only; 24V, 12V, 5V and 72V rails may remain live and the circuit must not be described as a safety-rated power disconnect.
The four Power Stage boards are energized progressively, logic-only and low-voltage first, before PDLC and 72V operation.
KiCad design files and physical pin contracts are not changed during software work unless the user explicitly requests a hardware design change.

An EN_GLOBAL falling edge immediately gates all CHx_ENABLE outputs in hardware and immediately lowers all MCU ENABLE requests in the GPIO ISR. Firmware promotes the event to a reset-required E-Stop latch only after ten consecutive 1 ms output samples remain low. A shorter LOW must remain high for ten consecutive samples, discard the prior command lease, and wait for a fresh valid full command before output may resume.
